name: Volvox.Quest
description: Create Discord quests, award XP, and rank members on seasonal leaderboards.
longDescription: Volvox.Quest gives Discord admins a bot and web dashboard for running community challenges. Schedule quests, choose what members need to submit, and award XP when you approve their submissions. Start a new leaderboard each season while members keep their all-time XP, and reward top ranks with Discord roles.
features: Create and schedule one-time or recurring quests
Review links, screenshots, written responses, check-ins, and quiz submissions
Award XP for approved submissions and eligible Discord messages
Reward leaderboard ranks with Discord roles

faq.question: How do I get started with Volvox.Quest?
faq.answer: Sign in with Discord at volvox.app and select a server that uses Volvox.Quest. If you manage a server, invite the bot before creating quests.

faq.question: Do members keep their XP between seasons?
faq.answer: Yes. Each season starts with a fresh leaderboard. Members keep their all-time XP, and previous season standings remain available.
